summary: The non_gaia project is a highly effective implementation using the CrewAI framework. It leverages LLM-driven agents to orchestrate complex tasks, meeting all functional requirements with a clear and distributed architecture.

findings.description: All functional requirements are explicitly addressed by specialized agents.
findings.evidence: Separate agents for emergency response, traffic monitoring, and resource coordination are present in the agents/ directory.

findings.description: The project follows a clean, modular structure with a central orchestration layer (CrewAI).
findings.evidence: Agents are defined in individual files and coordinated by a Crew in main.py.

findings.description: Communication is handled via task delegation and shared context provided by CrewAI.
findings.evidence: The run_simulation method defines a sequence of tasks that are executed by specific agents.

implementation_risks: Dependency on external LLM APIs for agent logic might introduce latency or cost issues in a real-time crisis scenario.
